name: Primer
description: GitHub's Primer design system on the t-* vocabulary: system font stack at 14px/1.5, 6px corners (3px checkboxes, 12px overlays and dialogs, pill Labels and Counters), 32/28/40px controls with 1px borders, bordered secondary Buttons on a subtle fill with a solid accent primary, danger text that fills on hover, invisible buttons, outline pill Labels, tinted Counters, solid StateLabels, UnderlineNav tabs, Box cards, DataTable tables, Flash banners, ActionMenu/ActionList overlays, a NavList sidebar with the accent bar, SegmentedControl, ProgressBar, Timeline and Blankslate.
notes: Translated, not vendored: Primer CSS and Primer React style their own class names (.btn, .Box, .Label, ActionList parts) with Primer's own colour variables, so the declarations are re-expressed on t-* selectors (SKIN-CONTRACT rule 5). Primer's functional colour roles map onto palette tokens (bgColor-default → canvas, muted/inset → inset, overlay → surface, borderColor-default → border, fg default/muted/disabled → text/muted/disabled, accent-emphasis → accent-solid with on-accent text); text on other solid tone fills uses --t-canvas. Shadows are skin-private (palettes reset --t-shadow-* in light mode). Primer's primary button is green on github.com; here it follows the palette accent like every other skin. StateLabel has only a solid look in Primer, so .t-state and data-variant=solid render alike. NavList group titles render larger than their items (tailor convention) instead of Primer's 12px muted heading. No Primer assets, Octicons or Mona Sans are shipped.
